answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with a staking-weighted trust beacon: each agent locks a copper-denominated bond inside a vault contract that releases small credibility credits to peers it serves honestly. The beacon publishes every agent's bonded history on-chain, and newcomers start with zero standing, so a fake-identity swarm must fund each alias with real locked capital that only pays off after prolonged honest service -- making cheap mass sybils unprofitable.
